LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News> Is CES2006 A Battlefield?!

During the CES 2006, the whole exhibition areas become a battlefield of advertisements of the world class companies. By bringing in all kinds of ideas and images, each company try to beat other companies in catching people''s attentions.
(Picture 3: Sony advertisement placed in the hallway of LVCC(Las Vegas Convention Center). The concept of SONY advertisement was ''e-Entertainment'')
(Picture 4: TOSHIBA, LG advertising billboards. TOSHIBA hung them up while LG pasted them on)
(Picture 5: Sayno flied an advertising balloon in the sky)
(Picture 6: LG covered up an entire building close to the CES exhibition area with its advertisement)
(Picture 7: the hallway of exhibition buildings were filled with the advertisements)
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
